Also known as the Vocation Quest or Desert Quest. A team with one player of each vocation crosses the maze beneath the Jakundaf Desert to the vocation room, where each one places an item of their vocation on a pedestal. If everything is right, the team is teleported to the reward room: a {item:Golden Bag} with 25 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins} for each participating vocation and a {item:Green Bag} with a {item:Protection Amulet}, {item:Ring of Healing}, {item:Magic Light Wand} and {item:Ankh}.
An old myth, almost buried by the sands of time, was discovered by brave adventurers who ventured through the complicated Desert Dungeon and found its secret.

Most players take the **short path** (sections 1 and 2). The long path (section 3) is optional and leads to the same place.

The dungeon is big and confusing, and some holes **have no matching rope spot**: if you fall, you need someone to pull you out with a rope and you may not even be able to get back to the team. Do not go down any hole unless the guide says so.
If the team cannot finish the quest, the only way out is the teleport next to the Gate of Expertise, which takes you to {npc:Adrenius}.
On PvP servers this quest is a common target for player killers. The reward room and the stairs at the exit are Protection Zone: do not leave those steps.
You can repeat the quest as many times as you like (for example to help other teams), but you only get the reward once.
Gather a team with one player of each vocation, each with their vocation item, and go to the Jakundaf Desert, between Venore and Thais.

The **Jakundaf Desert** is between Thais and Venore (northeast of Thais and west of Venore). In the middle of the desert look for the {item:Loose Stone Pile}. Use the {item:Shovel} to open it and go down the hole.
If the team has to give up halfway, the only way out is the teleport next to the {item:Gate of Expertise}, at the end of the short path: it takes you to {npc:Adrenius}, on the desert surface.
Going down to the spider floor
Go down **4 more times** until you reach a floor with {creature:Spider|Spiders}.
Spider floor: north, east and south
Go **north** and turn **east** as soon as you can. Then follow the cave **south** until you find the next stairs up. Go up.
If you take a wrong turn on this floor you may meet {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} and {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}. On the right path you do not meet them.
Follow the blue line north, east and then south. You may meet Bonelords and Fire Devils here.
Stairs to the west (do not go down the hole)
Go **west** until you find another set of stairs and go up.
Do **not** go down the hole to the south that has a {item:Warning Sign}.
Do **not** go down the hole! Only go up the stairs to the west.
Follow the cave **south** and go up the next stairs.
East and north to the last stairs
Go **east** and then **north**: you will find a hole — **do not** go down. Keep going **east** and **north** again and follow the path (northeast) to the last stairs. Go up.
You may meet a {creature:Slime} on this floor. Do not go down the hole.
Enter the level 20 {item:Gate of Expertise} to reach the vocation room. Next to the gate is the emergency teleport that takes you to {npc:Adrenius}, in case the team has to give up.

If you have a **Monk**, they should click on the floor in the middle of the room. The message *"Channeling knowledge of the ancient Merudri, you find a hidden platform."* appears, and a central pedestal (basin) and a switch show up.
Placing the items on the pedestals
Each player places their item on the pedestal of their vocation **before** stepping on the switch:
Correct position of the items on the pedestals
Vocation room: each vocation places its item in the indicated basin and then steps on the switch
After the item is on the pedestal, each player steps on their switch tile. The switch stays pressed if everything is right.
If the switch does not stay pressed, the item is wrong or you stepped on the tile before placing the item. Check the item on the pedestal, step off the tile and step on it again.
When all the switches are pressed, the **Paladin** pulls the {item:Lever|lever} in front of their tile. The whole team is teleported to the reward room. The vocation items are destroyed.

In the reward room there are two chests, one to the **west** and one to the **east**. One has the {item:Golden Bag} with 25 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins} for each participating vocation (125 with all five); the other has the {item:Green Bag} with {item:Protection Amulet}, {item:Magic Light Wand}, {item:Ring of Healing} and {item:Ankh}.
Golden Bag with Platinum Coins and Green Bag with Protection Amulet, Magic Light Wand, Ring of Healing and Ankh
Go **north** and go up the stairs to leave. You return to the Jakundaf Desert.
The exit stairs have no entrance from the other side: if you leave before opening the chests you are locked out and have to redo the quest.
Alternative path, completely optional, that leads to the same goal. You need a {item:Roll}, {spell:Levitate} or 3+ {item:Parcel|Parcels}, and 500 gp.
Inside the Desert Dungeon find {npc:Hagor}. Ask him about {key:Morrin} and give him a {item:Roll}. You receive the {item:Key 4022}.
Go to this door and open it with the {item:Key 4022}. Take the {item:Key 4009} from the chest.

Open this door with the {item:Key 4009} and enter the {wiki:Desert Dungeon Library|library}. Look for and read the books *"Dangers of Adventures"* by the author **Netlios** — they have the answers to the next test.
One player stands on a switch on the library floor. While they are there, the way to this point is not blocked: go there and look for the missing book.

Look for {npc:Adrenius} in the desert and ask him about {key:Netlios}. Pay him 500 gp and he starts a test; all the answers are in Netlios's *"Dangers of Adventures"* books. If you pass, you receive the {item:Key 4023}.

With the vocation team, open this door with the {item:Key 4023}. Each player steps into the teleport of their vocation and faces 2 creatures: {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} (Knight), {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers} (Paladin), {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} (Sorcerer) and {wiki:Bears|Bears} (Druid). There are signs that indicate the items needed for the next step.

Leave the dungeon with the team the same way you came down (or through the teleport next to the Gate of Expertise, which drops you next to {npc:Adrenius}, on the surface) and get the items indicated on the signs. Then follow the path to the vocation room, place the items in the right places and pull the lever (as in section 2). The whole team is teleported to the reward room. To leave the reward room, go **north** and go up the stairs (see "Leaving" in section 2).
You only get the reward once, but you can help other teams (as one of the vocations) as many times as you like.
Fun fact: the NPC {npc:Avar Tar} claims he did this quest alone by learning the magic of the four vocations.
